race.description: Club Menangle Sue Kelly Ladyship Stakes Mbl Pace (L)
race.comment: Sydney gets a first look at boom mare THE ART OF SUCCESS (9) who heads north on a 10-race winning streak. Huge effort to win the Vicbred Final at Melton last start, drawing on the back row and working hard but proving too strong. Kept fresh since but can add to the picket fence. Stablemate LET HER ROLL (10) also comes with winning form, using the sprint lane to land the G2 Ladyship Cup at Melton last start. Draws wide but her best form measures up. A wide draw presents more of a challenge to GUNNA RELOAD (11) but she was dominant in both rounds of the Breeders Challenge 4M series at this circuit and distance, cruising home by 11m in last week's final. WICKED CONFESSION (6) continued her good form when runner-up to the Queensland Derby winner here last week and came from a wider barrier to place behind LET HER ROLL prior. Draws well enough to be a danger.
